name: Sheraton Grand Danang Beach Resort & Spa
insider_take: Where the emerald waters of the East Sea meet world-class luxury — the Sheraton Grand Danang delivers a Vietnamese coastal escape like no other, right on the legendary My Khe Beach, once dubbed "one of the most beautiful beaches on the planet" by Forbes.
whats_special: Stretching along a pristine 700-meter private beachfront, this resort is one of Da Nang's most celebrated properties. With its dramatic architecture, five sparkling pools — including a breathtaking 150-meter lagoon pool — and the indulgent Shine Spa, it blends Vietnamese cultural elegance with Sheraton's signature hospitality. Guests are also perfectly positioned between two UNESCO World Heritage Sites: the ancient town of Hoi An and the imperial city of Hue, both reachable within an hour.
pro_tip: Book a room on an upper floor facing the ocean for sunrise views over the East Sea that are genuinely unforgettable — the golden light over My Khe Beach at dawn is worth setting your alarm for. Marriott Luminous members can enjoy exclusive perks, so make sure your account is linked before arrival.
dont_miss: The Lagoon Pool: At 150 meters long, it's one of Vietnam's largest resort pools — a must for a leisurely afternoon float. Shine Spa: Indulge in a traditional Vietnamese-inspired treatment — the herbal compress massage is a standout. Marble Mountains Day Trip: Just minutes away, these five limestone hills conceal hidden caves, Buddhist sanctuaries, and panoramic city views. Da Nang Street Food Scene: Head into the city for Mi Quang (turmeric noodles) and Banh Mi — Da Nang's local take on Vietnamese classics is not to be missed.
pros: Prime beachfront location on My Khe Beach with direct access to the South China Sea
Expansive resort-style pools and luxurious spa facilities offering world-class relaxation
Elegantly appointed rooms and suites featuring stunning ocean or mountain views
Exceptional dining experiences with multiple restaurants showcasing Vietnamese and international cuisine
Exclusive Marriott Bonvoy Luminous perks including complimentary breakfast and resort credits for eligible members
cons: Located outside Da Nang city center, requiring transportation for urban exploration
Large-scale resort atmosphere may feel less intimate for travelers seeking boutique experiences
